grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Learning Goals and Habits: A Conversation at the Library
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习材料，适合A2水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选题、填空题和判断题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
A: Hi, Mei. What are you doing here at the library?
B: Hi, Tom. I'm looking for a book about study habits. I want to improve my English.
A: That's great. Do you study English every day?
B: Yes, I do. I usually study for one hour in the evening. But sometimes I'm too tired.
A: What time do you start?
B: I start at 8 p.m. and finish at 9 p.m. I always review new words before bed.
A: Do you study with friends?
B: No, I don't. I prefer to study alone. But I often listen to English podcasts while I cook.
A: That's a good idea. Do you take notes?
B: Yes, I do. I write down new words in a notebook. I'm also watching English movies these days.
A: Are you learning anything else?
B: I'm taking an online course. It's about grammar. I have a test next week.
A: Good luck! Do you have a study plan?
B: Yes, I do. I make a weekly plan every Sunday. I write down my goals for the week.
A: That sounds organized. How many hours do you study on weekends?
B: I study for two hours on Saturday and one hour on Sunday. I sometimes take a break and go for a walk.
A: Do you think you will reach your goal?
B: I hope so. My goal is to speak English fluently. I'm working hard to achieve it.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes）连用。现在进行时表示正在进行的动作，结构为be + 动词-ing。do/does 用于一般现在时的疑问句和否定句。
grammar.example: I usually study for one hour in the evening. (一般现在时) / I'm looking for a book about study habits. (现在进行时) / Do you study English every day? (do 问句)

options: She always goes to the library.
She always go to the library.
She always going to the library.
She always is go to the library.
answers: She always goes to the library.
questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加-s，所以选A。

options: Does he studies English every day?
Do he study English every day?
Does he study English every day?
Is he study English every day?
answers: Does he study English every day?
questions.explanation: 主语he是第三人称单数，疑问句用Does，动词用原形study，所以选C。

options: They are watching a movie now.
They is watching a movie now.
answers: They are watching a movie now.
questions.explanation: now表示正在进行的动作，用现在进行时，主语They是复数，be动词用are，所以选A。

options: I am often listen to music.
questions.explanation: often表示频率，用一般现在时，主语I，动词用原形listen，所以选A。
